prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Pleasanton CA for a checkup and cleaning?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” dentist, and I can’t verify today’s appointment availability or recent patient reviews. For a routine checkup and cleaning in Pleasanton, prioritize a **general/family dentist** with:

- Recent consistently strong Google/Yelp reviews, especially mentioning cleanings and gentle hygienists  
- Your dental insurance in network (if applicable)  
- Clear new-patient pricing if uninsured  
- Availability for a hygiene visit—not just a consultation  
- Conservative treatment recommendations and transparent estimates  

A good starting point is to search **“Pleasanton CA family dentist cleaning”** on Google Maps and compare the most recent reviews—not only the overall star score. Call the top 2–3 offices and ask: “Can I book a new-patient exam and cleaning in the same visit, and what will my out-of-pocket cost be?”

If you tell me your insurance plan, neighborhood/cross streets, whether you prefer a gentle/anxiety-friendly dentist, and whether you need evening/weekend hours, I can help you narrow the choice.
